_comment: Owner-approved conflict resolutions. Each entry selects the source batch (mapping code) whose value becomes AUTHORITATIVE for one conflicted (period, domain, metric). Only the project owner may add entries; every entry must carry a reason, approver and approval date.

resolutions.reason: Project-owner approved 2025 institutional annual Total Water Usage reference (195,708 KL = TWAD 39,708 + Borewell 156,000). The 2025 monthly 'Water Consumption (KL)' column (sum 39,835 KL) is not used as total water usage.
